rows.heading: DPE Guidelines for Administrative Ministries & CPSEs (printed compendium) - Rule 4. General
rows.quote_snippet: (xiv) not place oneself under any financial or other obligations to any individual or organization which may influence the employee in the performance of one’s official duties; (xv) not misuse one’s position as public servant and not take decisions in order to derive financial or material benefits for oneself, one’s family or one’s friends;

rows.heading: DPE Guidelines for Administrative Ministries & CPSEs (printed compendium) - Rule 12. Gifts
rows.quote_snippet: Note - An employee of the CPSE shall avoid acceptance of lavish or frequent hospitality from any individual or firm having official dealings with the employee.
